meta.subject: 英文
meta.title: Unit 1 What Do You Want To Eat?

questions.question: A: What do you want to eat? B: I want to eat ______.
questions.explanation: want to eat 後面接食物名稱。

questions.question: 'I want to eat a sandwich.' means '我想吃三明治'。
questions.explanation: want to eat 表示想要吃。

questions.question: A: What does she want to eat? B: She ______ to eat rice.
A: Do you want to eat pizza? B: Yes, ______.
questions.explanation: Do you want...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, I do。
